_comment: Flavor label per power-pair combo (2026-09-05 depth pass), keyed by the two power ids sorted alphabetically and joined with '+'. Purely presentational — board_view.gd derives the actual tint (blend of each power's own _POW_FX_TINT) and sound (both powers' own sfx ids layered, never a brand-new synth def) from the pair itself, so this file only needs a name per combination, not a whole new effect spec. Every same-power and cross-power pair among the 5 existing powers (bomb/lightning/freeze/chain/rainbow) is listed so no combo falls back to a generic label.
